beats.text: Factories shutter and transit halts as millions demand urgent rent action.

beats.speaker: everyman
beats.text: Construction collapsed after the 2008 bubble burst.
beats.name: Everyman

beats.text: Average rent nearly doubles while officials demand seven hundred fifty thousand new homes urgently.

beats.speaker: union_leader
beats.text: Rights are won on the streets first. Then in institutions.
beats.name: Union organiser

beats.text: Parliamentary gridlock forces the prime minister to dissolve congress for a late November vote.
A tragic train collision pauses campaigning while unions force housing onto the national ballot.
Voters now choose between emergency tenant protections and strict market-driven supply solutions.

plan.caption: Spain halts with its first general strike in fourteen years over soaring rent costs. Millions demand emergency tenant protections ahead of a late November snap election. Watch the full breakdown on our YouTube channel; link in bio. 🏠📉
